caption: The image shows a round plate, predominantly in grayscale, with an intricate design. The border of the plate features a repeating pattern of shells, seaweed, and various marine elements. The inner border is decorated with a bead-like pattern. The central area of the plate displays a landscape scene with a large waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff into a body of water below. Two small human figures stand near the base of the waterfall on the right-hand side, with trees visible in the background on the left. The entire composition uses varying shades of gray to depict depth and texture, with the marine motifs on the rim rendered in high detail and the central scene dominated by the waterfall and surrounding natural elements.
title: Plate
